About

A bit about me…

I'm Lemmy, a senior product designer based in Lagos, Nigeria. I design products across B2C and B2B software, conversational AI, fintech and Web3, for teams in India, Dubai, the UK and the US.

Most recently, I led product design at SOIN Global, a social intelligence and influencer marketplace for Web3 brands and creators. Alongside it, I took Travon, a multi-chain meme coin trading terminal, from discovery to MVP.

Before that, I spent a year leading design at Alpha Blockz, a $100M Web3 incubator, shipping websites, design systems and investor decks that helped its startups raise $5M+. Over the same stretch I worked with Avinya Labs in Dubai on an AI-powered DeFi app and Telegram mini-games.

I started in 2022 at BeCreative Agency, redesigning client websites, then moved into enterprise software at Hydrogen HR, working on HR, payroll and job board platforms. I studied Computer Science at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka.

Altogether, the startups I've designed for have secured over $10M in funding and reached 50k+ users.
